*Piṭṭhiduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 18.24) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka. The text represents an analytical treatment combining the *Piṭṭhiduka* (the supplementary or "back" dyads) and the *Hetuduka* (the root dyad) classifications of the Abhidhamma mātikā.
